_about: Server-side demo personas for the test console Demo tab and the [DEMO] CRM seeder (features/demo). Mirrors .superpowers/sdd/2026-11-09-phone-caller-context/personas.json and the Phone tab's personas.ts (same ids, numbers, attribute keys). All numbers are fake (+600000001xx is not a Malaysian mobile range). Differences from the sdd copy: every conversation carries the [DEMO] history message the seeder posts, Farid has an RSA incident, each persona lists what its card shows, and Nurul's conversation has NO `escalate` label (on a live tenant with ESCALATION_ALL_CHANNELS_ENABLED it would send the EM-7 escalation email to the dealer and start the reminder ladder; the open case + case_type Complaint is what the phone demo reads).

personas.label: Ahmad (known customer)
personas.description: Proton X50, plate DMO 1101, dealer Petaling Jaya.
personas.scriptHint: Ask to book a service for your X50.
shows: Known caller: the assistant confirms "Ahmad" and the X50 (plate ending 1101).
One resolved past service-booking conversation, dealer Petaling Jaya.

conversations.message: [DEMO] Hi, I would like to book the 20,000 km service for my Proton X50 at Petaling Jaya next week.

Proton Saga, plate ending 1102, dealer Petaling Jaya.

conversations.message: [DEMO] Saya ingin membuat aduan: penghawa dingin Proton Saga saya tidak sejuk selepas servis minggu lepas.

personas.label: New caller (not in CRM)
personas.scriptHint: Give your name, plate DMO 1106 and say you use the Shah Alam service centre (not a configured dealer: stored as text, no label).
